up: List all molecules reported in the document with CHEMBL ID CHEMBL4699440. For each molecule, provide its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Order the results by the ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4699440'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
